C1_schedule_to_gt_identity: fraction of supplied events carrying a GT identity
C2_generated_to_supplied_adherence: fraction of identified supplied events matched by a generated event
C3_full_chain_P_S_G: fraction of supplied events with a complete eligible chain
C4_gt_beats_excluded: fraction of GT beats absent from the own-centre comparison
C5_generated_beats_excluded: fraction of generated beats absent from the own-centre comparison
rule: every morphology metric row must carry all five; morphology reported without coverage is INVALID
